title: Content handoffs và mobile review acceptance
scope_items: Acceptance Target 1 (Source chain reaches approved brief): Verified complete bidirectional provenance lineage connecting Trend Radar (M02) -> Opportunity Board (M04) -> Idea Engine (M05) -> Script Lab (M06) -> Asset Brief (M06). The downstream production readiness event ('script.ready_for_production') is emitted strictly when approval_state = approved AND the linked Asset Brief is complete (non-empty output type, format, positive duration, and non-empty continuity JSON), adhering to RULE-M06-005, RULE-M06-006, AC-M06-002, and AC-2.

Acceptance Target 2 (Concurrent edits preserve data): Implemented stale review conflict detection (EC-M06-003) returning HTTP 409 Conflict (ErrStaleReviewConflict) whenever an author modifies or saves new scenes while a reviewer holds an older expected version. Concurrent edits preserve author revisions without silent data clobbering, snapshotting version history to script_versions and notifying reviewers to refresh.

Acceptance Target 3 (No publish side effects from creative assistant): Creative assistant & Copilot prompt routing enforces strict publish-guard inspections across English and Vietnamese keywords (e.g. 'đăng bài', 'đăng video', 'lên lịch', 'publish', 'schedule', 'auto-post'). Creative assistant is restricted solely to draft generation and scene rewriting; zero publish events, zero publish jobs, and zero external connector mutations are triggered (M11 Publish Hub deferred strictly to Phase P5).

Web Frontend (SvelteKit 5): Implemented Script Editor (W016: /scripts/[id]), Script Review (W017: /scripts/[id]/review), and Asset Brief Editor (W020: /scripts/[id]/brief) along with SourceChainLineage, ConcurrentConflictBanner, CreativeAssistantPublishGuard, and comprehensive Vitest unit tests (all 161 tests passing).

Mobile Frontend (Flutter 3.47.9): Implemented Mobile Script Editor (M011: /scripts/[id]), SourceChainLineageWidget, enhanced MobileScriptReviewView, and comprehensive widget and unit tests covering all three acceptance targets, readthrough timer, and ready-for-production gating (all 138 mobile tests passing, flutter analyze 0 warnings).
